title: GeopoliticalQA: Benchmarking Retrieval and Generation over Intelligence Reports
abstract: arXiv:2610.12617v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Geopolitical and strategic intelligence reports constitute a rich source of expert knowledge and have increasing value in the current political climate, but their heterogeneity and analytical complexity pose challenges for retrieval-augmented question answering. We introduce a benchmark for grounded question answering over 415 open-source geopolitical and strategic intelligence reports, comprising 5,525 document-grounded question-answer pairs spanning factual, inferential, comparative, and risk-oriented questions. We propose a document-aware generation pipeline that profiles reports before generating questions and validate dataset quality through expert annotation and an LLM-as-judge protocol. Using the benchmark, we evaluate 15 retrieval systems and six open-weight LLMs for RAG. We find that models perform similarly on document-level retrieval, while at the harder chunk level retrieval quality is not driven by embedding-model scale: bge

translated_title: GeopoliticalQA：面向情报报告的检索与生成基准测试
translated_abstract: 地缘政治与战略情报报告是专家知识的丰富来源，在当前政治环境下价值日益凸显，但其异质性和分析复杂性给检索增强问答带来了挑战。我们提出了一个基于415份开源地缘政治与战略情报报告的有据可依问答基准，包含5,525个基于文档的问答对，涵盖事实性、推理性、比较性和风险导向型问题。我们提出了一种文档感知的生成流水线，在生成问题前先对报告进行画像分析，并通过专家标注和LLM-as-judge协议验证了数据集质量。利用该基准，我们评估了15个检索系统和六个开放权重LLM用于RAG。我们发现各模型在文档级检索上表现相近，而在更具挑战性的块级检索上，检索质量并非由嵌入模型规模驱动：bge
tldr: 该论文构建了基于415份开源地缘政治与战略情报报告、包含5,525个问答对的问答基准GeopoliticalQA，并通过评估15个检索系统和六个开放权重LLM发现，模型在文档级检索上表现相近，而更具挑战性的块级检索质量并不取决于嵌入模型的规模。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GeopoliticalQA, a grounded question-answering benchmark of 5,525 question-answer pairs over 415 open-source geopolitical and strategic intelligence reports, and finds through evaluating 15 retrieval systems and six open-weight LLMs that while document-level retrieval performance is similar across models, chunk-level retrieval quality is not driven by embedding-model scale.
